frozen_protocol.preprocessing: per-window PPG z-score; per-axis per-window IMU z-score; train-split-only HR target normalization

models.model_a_ppg_only: PPGOnlyHRModel (Conv1DEncoder in_channels=1 + Linear head) - imported unmodified from ml/train_ppg_dalia_imu_ablation.py
models.model_b_ppg_plus_imu: PPGPlusIMUHRModel (Conv1DEncoder x2 + ModalityFusionTransformer + Linear head) - imported unmodified
models.model_c_ppg_plus_shuffled_imu: Same class as Model B; IMU windows shuffled within-subject via shuffle_imu_within_subject() - imported unmodified

frozen_protocol.shuffle_seed_policy: Model C's shuffle-permutation seed == the training seed for that replicate (matches the original script's coupling of shuffle-seed and training-seed into one variable; documented, not silently changed).
frozen_protocol.only_variable_across_replicates: training/model-initialization randomness (torch.manual_seed) and, coupled to it by the policy above, the shuffle-C permutation realization

interpretation_thresholds_frozen_before_.STRONGLY_REPLICATED_POSITIVE: seed_direction_count >= 4 of 5 favor B AND mean(A-B) > 0
interpretation_thresholds_frozen_before_.REPLICATED_BUT_VARIABLE: seed_direction_count == 3 of 5 favor B AND mean(A-B) > 0
interpretation_thresholds_frozen_before_.MIXED: seed_direction_count <= 2 of 5 favor B, or mean(A-B) approximately 0

provenance.performance_note: torch.set_num_threads(4) set at module import - a runtime/infrastructure choice (measured ~28x faster than the PyTorch default of 20 threads on this 20-logical-core CPU-only VM for this model size), not a scientific parameter.

unsupported_claims: Causal attribution of the exact fraction of benefit to 'synchronization' vs 'context' - the shuffle control is descriptive, not a proof of causal decomposition.
Any claim this replicates across datasets - PTT and PPG-DaLiA are separate, non-comparable experiments (see docs/SENSOR_MARGINAL_VALUE_METHODOLOGY.md).
